title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Daring Rakhwala
desc: An intoxicated dog bites a security guard, unleashes a zombie outbreak. A traffic officer takes up the responsibility to find the antidote.

title: Chatrapathi
desc: Sivaji and his family are uprooted from their Sri Lankan community and wind up as bonded labourers in Visakhapatnam. However, he rises to become a saviour of the oppressed, like his heroic namesake.

title: Thaye Bhuvaneshwari
desc: Prema, an ardent devotee of Goddess Soundarya, encounters an evil man, who forces her into submission. However, her belief in the Almighty stands unwavered.

title: Sheshnaag
desc: Pritam and Banu, two shape-shifting snakes in human form, seek protection from a young man when an evil priest tries to hunt them down and use them in a ritual for wealth and immortality.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Bimbisara
desc: An ancient evil emperor is trapped in a mirror and transported to the modern world.
